Path: business objects, records and views | 缺项 (no item re-opens a stored custom dashboard date range) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:reports` · `pm:queue`

Triage: lands in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardFilterBar.tsx`, the `dateRange` select's custom item ⇒ `domain:ui`. Rationale: with a custom range stored, picking 「Custom…」 again fires no `onValueChange`, because Radix fires only on a changed value, so the calendar never opens. The author must pick a preset first and start from an empty range. It is a UX defect with a workaround ⇒ **p3**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T21:30Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments) and PR objectui#10838 (merged).

**No serial constraint.** PR objectui#10838 merged on 2026-09-27. Its `defaultMonth` becomes visible once this lands.

**Execution notes.**
1. Open the custom popover from something that fires on an unchanged value: the custom item's own `onSelect`, or a separate 「Edit range」 trigger shown while a custom range is stored. Pick the one that survives the focus-return the dev saw in happy-dom, measured in a real browser in the same PR.
2. Pin it through the real select: with a custom range stored, 「Custom…」 shows the calendar on the stored `from` month. The preset → 「Custom…」 path is the control.

Whichever is chosen must survive the focus-return, measured in a real browser. Also a pin through the real select, and a `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`. Stop on breach; explain in the report.

Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-09-27T21:59Z at objectui `origin/main` `4aebea00a`, which carries PR objectui#10838 (`defaultMonth`). None of the 9 open PRs touches `DashboardFilterBar.tsx`. The card was filed by seat #4 and is unassigned and unclaimed.

  - The preset → 「Custom…」 "control" path was itself broken for users: the calendar mounted, then the select's focus return removed it about 70–80 ms later.
  - Declining the 「Edit range」 trigger was right: it would add visible text and would not meet execution note 2.

  - Patch round `5860911199` restored that path, added the load-bearing `!selectOpen` guard, and added three pins.
  - Delta record `5860980809` — `Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `193cc4a4faa41102e52907fe46bc895391520e5c` (the current head), independence pair present, **PASS**. The reviewer re-measured in Chromium, reproduced base 5 failed / round-1 1 failed / head 11 passed and all five ablations on exactly their own cases, and read every changeset sentence as true.
